meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 使用此技能时,Claude会在虚拟终端中无头运行指定应用,模拟输入并记录每一帧,叠加操作说明后合成视频,生成含时间线、检查结果和截图的摘要页面,并用pixel open打开。
howto.when: 当用户要求验证通过kitty图形协议渲染的应用,或要求产出带视频和检查摘要的验证报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我写个验证脚本,测试滚动时光标是否保持原位。
say.note: 会录制操作并生成带检查结果的摘要页。

say.text: 验证一下这个打字应用,录视频并生成摘要页面。
say.note: 会打开包含视频和时间线的summary.html。

say.text: 用verify技能跑一遍,检查像素颜色和帧数。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude runs the app headlessly in a pty, simulates input, records each frame, overlays descriptions, encodes a video, and generates a summary page with timeline, checks and stills, then opens it via pixel open.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to verify an app rendered via the kitty graphics protocol, or requests a verification report with video and checks.

say_en.text: Write a verification script to test that scrolling keeps the cursor anchored.
say_en.note: Records the run and opens a summary with checks.

say_en.text: Verify this typing app, record video and generate the summary page.
say_en.note: Opens summary.html with timeline and video.

say_en.text: Run verify, assert on pixel colors and frame counts.
say_en.note: Reports pass/fail based on real assertions.
